haitian-creole--haitian-creole-foundatio.title: Haitian Creole Foundations
haitian-creole--haitian-creole-foundatio.description: An A0-to-A1 Haitian Creole course that develops listening, speaking, reading, sentence building, and writing together from the first module.
haitian-creole--haitian-creole-foundatio.moreComingSoon: More Haitian Creole Foundations lessons are coming soon.

haitian-creole-foundations-1-sounds-of-k.title: Sounds of Kreyòl
haitian-creole-foundations-1-sounds-of-k.description: Build a first sound-to-spelling map for Kreyòl and begin recognizing, saying, reading, arranging, and writing short high-frequency words.
outcomes: Recognize core Kreyòl sound and spelling patterns in short familiar words.
Listen for and repeat short sound patterns and first words.
Read, arrange, and write a small set of high-frequency words using official Kreyòl spelling.
why: Builds confidence with sounds of kreyòl.
Prepares learners for the next skills in the course.

haitian-creole-foundations-2-bonjou.title: Bonjou!
haitian-creole-foundations-2-bonjou.description: Use greetings, polite expressions, and simple social responses in short everyday exchanges.
outcomes: Recognize and use common greetings, polite expressions, and leave-taking language.
Ask how someone is, answer naturally, and return the question.
Follow and participate in a short connected greeting conversation.
why: Prepares learners for the next skills in the course.

haitian-creole-foundations-3-who-are-you.title: Who Are You?
haitian-creole-foundations-3-who-are-you.description: Introduce yourself, ask another person's name, and exchange a few simple personal details.
outcomes: Ask and answer someone's name.
Ask and answer where someone lives.
Combine greetings, names, and residence in a connected beginner conversation.
why: Builds confidence with who are you?.
Prepares learners for the next skills in the course.

haitian-creole-foundations-4-talking-abo.title: Talking About Things
haitian-creole-foundations-4-talking-abo.description: Name everyday objects and use simple patterns to identify, describe, and point out things around you.
outcomes: Use yon, familiar definite noun phrases, and plural yo with everyday things.
Express possession with thing + possessor and with se pou.
Use sa a and sa yo to point out things and combine them with ownership.
why: Builds confidence with talking about things.
Prepares learners for the next skills in the course.

haitian-creole-foundations-5-what-are-yo.title: What Are You Doing?
haitian-creole-foundations-5-what-are-yo.description: Talk about simple actions happening now and understand short action-centered sentences.
outcomes: Use common action words in simple present statements and routines.
Use ap to describe an action in progress and recognize common short forms.
Ask Kisa ou ap fè?, answer naturally, and distinguish now from routine.
why: Builds confidence with what are you doing?.
Prepares learners for the next skills in the course.

haitian-creole-foundations-6-questions-a.title: Questions & Answers
haitian-creole-foundations-6-questions-a.description: Recognize and produce core beginner question patterns and short natural answers.
outcomes: Use Èske to ask familiar yes/no questions and give complete answers.
Choose familiar information-question forms based on whether you need how, what, place, person, or quantity.
Mix yes/no and information questions inside a connected beginner conversation.
why: Prepares learners for the next skills in the course.

haitian-creole-foundations-7-numbers-tim.title: Numbers, Time & Everyday Life
haitian-creole-foundations-7-numbers-tim.description: Use beginner numbers and time expressions in useful everyday contexts.
outcomes: Recognize and use numbers one through twenty inside simple everyday quantities.
Recognize full-hour and half-hour clock expressions and ask time with Akilè.
Combine everyday time expressions, routines, and familiar questions in a simple schedule conversation.
why: Builds confidence with numbers, time & everyday life.
Prepares learners for the next skills in the course.

haitian-creole-foundations-8-my-first-kr.title: My First Kreyòl Conversation
haitian-creole-foundations-8-my-first-kr.description: Combine greetings, identity, objects, actions, questions, numbers, and time in a first sustained beginner conversation.
outcomes: Recognize how familiar Course 1 conversation moves connect instead of memorizing one fixed script.
Rehearse short scenes about identity, things, actions, questions, quantities, and time.
Understand and produce a sustained beginner conversation using language accumulated across the course.
why: Builds confidence with my first kreyòl conversation.
Prepares learners for the next skills in the course.

haitian-creole--haitian-creole-foundatio.title: Learn, Listen & Speak
haitian-creole--haitian-creole-foundatio.description: Introduce the module language, hear it in context, and begin producing it aloud.

haitian-creole--haitian-creole-foundatio.title: Read, Build, Write & Use It
haitian-creole--haitian-creole-foundatio.description: Read and reconstruct the language, write it, use it in context, and finish with review.
bullets: Read, Build, and Write First Words
Use Sounds in a Mini Exchange

haitian-creole--haitian-creole-foundatio.title: Greetings and Conversation
haitian-creole--haitian-creole-foundatio.description: Build from useful greetings and polite expressions into a complete two-way beginner conversation.
bullets: Ask, Answer, and Keep It Going

haitian-creole--haitian-creole-foundatio.title: Names, Places & Introductions
haitian-creole--haitian-creole-foundatio.description: Move from exchanging names to exchanging where you live, then connect both with Module 2 greetings.

haitian-creole--haitian-creole-foundatio.title: Things, Ownership & Demonstratives
haitian-creole--haitian-creole-foundatio.description: Build useful noun phrases, say who things belong to, and point out one or several objects.
bullets: One Thing, the Thing, More Than One

haitian-creole--haitian-creole-foundatio.title: Actions, Now & Routines
haitian-creole--haitian-creole-foundatio.description: Talk about familiar actions, distinguish routines from actions happening now, and ask what someone is doing.

haitian-creole--haitian-creole-foundatio.title: Questions & Answers
haitian-creole--haitian-creole-foundatio.description: Ask yes/no questions, choose information questions, and keep a short conversation moving.
bullets: Yes or No? Ask with Èske
Ask for the Information You Need

haitian-creole--haitian-creole-foundatio.title: Numbers, Time & Everyday Life
haitian-creole--haitian-creole-foundatio.description: Count familiar things, understand basic clock time, and use time expressions inside an everyday schedule.

haitian-creole--haitian-creole-foundatio.title: My First Kreyòl Conversation
haitian-creole--haitian-creole-foundatio.description: Map the conversation, rehearse useful scenes, then complete a sustained beginner exchange.
